name: neo
note: MacBook Neo (Apple A18 Pro, 8 GB). Reached through the SSH host alias `neo` that Nick sets up on each development machine; the folder is the only place this build may use there.
hardware: MacBook Neo (Mac17,5): Apple A18 Pro, 2 performance + 4 efficiency CPU cores, 5-core GPU, Metal 4, 8 GB shared memory, 2408x1506 Liquid Retina, macOS 27.2.1 (2026-11-15)
account: the user logged in at the screen (set as User in the `neo` SSH alias), so a build started over SSH opens on the real display

folders.loop: ~/RidgelineTest (the only place the remote loop writes)
folders.shared: ~/FamilyShare, synced with the Mac mini only; builds as FamilyShare/Ridgeline/Ridgeline.zip

network: Tailscale tag:family: development machines may connect in; the Neo can reach only the Mac mini's Syncthing port, so everything is pushed to it, never pulled
rules: play and test only: no Godot, git checkout, Python packages or source on it
never start bench or play if it was touched in the last 300 s (the builder never passes --now)
no Accessibility, Automation or Screen Recording permissions granted; ask a human if ever needed
honest_runs_need: plugged in, Low Power Mode off, lid open, screen on, untouched; power and low-power state are recorded in every run
first_contact: Nick accepted the Neo's SSH host key on the Fedora laptop on 2026-11-15; each other development machine needs `ssh neo true` once, by hand, before the loop can use it
